en.tagline: Audit a website and fix findings in code, then re-audit
en.summary: This skill runs a squirrelscan audit on a website using the squirrel CLI or the hosted MCP server. It returns a report covering SEO, performance, security, accessibility and other rule categories. It then maps each finding to the source file behind it, applies approved fixes in batches, and re-audits until the score reaches a target.
problem: A site can have many findings across SEO, performance, security, accessibility and content. The report says what is wrong, but not which template, component or content file causes it, and it is often unclear which findings matter most.

With this skill, the agent reads the findings, checks with you before changing anything that may be intentional, and works through the fixes in batches. Each batch is followed by a re-audit, so you can see the before and after scores.
fit: Finding and fixing SEO, accessibility, security or performance issues on a live site
Working through a large audit report in batches with a re-audit after each batch
Checking a site's score against a target such as B or A before sign-off
unfit: Narrow single-topic checks, which have their own skills in the same repo
Sites you cannot change in code or content, or sites where you cannot run audits and cloud credits are not available
steps: Run `squirrel auth status` and tell the user what a signed-in audit costs and leaves behind, then get approval.
Run `squirrel audit <url> --format llm` at a chosen level (quick, surface or full) to get a report.
Pull the full findings with `squirrel report <audit-id> --format json`, since the LLM format shows only a sample.
Confirm with the user which findings to fix and which are intentional, then look up each rule's fix on its docs page.
Find the source file behind each approved finding, apply the fixes in batches, and check that the project still builds.
Re-audit with `--refresh` after deploys and compare before and after scores until the target is met.

zh.tagline: 审计网站并修复代码中的问题，再重新审计
zh.summary: 该技能使用 squirrel CLI 或托管的 MCP 服务器对网站运行 squirrelscan 审计。报告涵盖 SEO、性能、安全、无障碍等规则类别。随后，它会将每项问题对应到背后的源文件，分批应用已确认的修复，并重新审计，直到分数达到目标。
problem: 一个网站可能在 SEO、性能、安全、无障碍和内容方面有大量问题。报告只说明哪里有问题，却没说明是哪个模板、组件或内容文件造成的，也往往看不出哪些问题最重要。
使用该技能后，代理会先读取问题列表，在改动可能是有意设计的内容之前先与你确认，然后分批处理修复。每批修复后都会重新审计，你可以看到前后的分数变化。
fit: 在线上网站上查找并修复 SEO、无障碍、安全或性能问题
分批处理篇幅较大的审计报告，每批之后重新审计
在结案前检查网站分数是否达到 B 或 A 等目标
unfit: 只关注单一主题的窄向检查，这类任务在同一仓库中有各自的技能
无法通过代码或内容进行修改的网站，或无法运行审计、没有云端积分的情况
steps: 运行 `squirrel auth status`，告诉用户已登录时一次审计的费用及其留下的内容，并获得同意。
以选定的级别（quick、surface 或 full）运行 `squirrel audit <url> --format llm`，获得报告。
用 `squirrel report <audit-id> --format json` 导出完整问题列表，因为 LLM 格式只显示一部分。
与用户确认哪些问题需要修复、哪些属于有意设计，然后查阅每条规则在文档页面上的修复方法。
找到每个已批准问题背后的源文件，分批应用修复，并确认项目仍可正常构建。
部署后使用 `--refresh` 重新审计，比较前后分数，直到达到目标。
